usage_policy:
Tarot / element / zodiac fields below are REGISTRY DATA for the author's own
series (Rider-Waite-style card prompts, zodiac prompts). They are NOT batch
material. Without the author's explicit per-request direction, NO card, sign,
or ability symbolism may appear in any batch prompt — not in POS, not in NEG,
not in theses, palettes, or prompt naming. Batch prompts use the OC's
APPEARANCE and origin-continuity motifs only. Card/zodiac assignments stay
here so the author can look them up for HIS series.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────
